purpose: Verify generated POINT callback delivery for WCS location and separately modeled extrusion, thickness, and X-axis angle fields.

authority.relevantFields: Group 10/20/30 is the POINT location in WCS; 210/220/230 is the extrusion vector; 39 is optional thickness; 50 is optional X-axis angle.

scopeLimit: Generated same-library DXF transport only. Does not qualify independent interoperability, DWG POINT parsing, or native point-symbol rendering.
claimEffect: No format or consumer support claim changes.
